c53a7be683.q: Why did Paxos obtain a New York trust company license in 2015 when most other stablecoin companies were operating without regulatory oversight?
c53a7be683.a: Paxos was founded in 2012 and became the first company to get a New York trust company license back in 2015, then converted that to an OCC national trust company in December of last year. Walter Hesert explains that Paxos set up the business to operate out of highly regulated entities because they believed in mass adoption of the technology and wanted to work with the most trusted and discerning firms in the world. Being regulated like a bank from the outset, with prudential oversight from regulators, was ahead of its time but differentiated Paxos when working with major financial institutions.

2229d717c4.q: How does Paxos's regulatory approach compare to Circle and Tether in the stablecoin market?
2229d717c4.a: The three largest stablecoin issuers are Tether (least regulated, explicitly avoiding regulatory oversight), Circle (partnered with Visa, BlackRock, and BNY but without prudential regulatory oversight of USDC issuance), and Paxos (regulated like a bank with prudential oversight since its first stablecoin issuance in 2018). Paxos subjects itself to oversight not just on consumer-facing activities but on every aspect of stablecoin issuance, while Tether is unregulated and Circle lacks regulatory oversight despite trust-building partnerships.

9104a902f4.q: How did the GENIUS Act affect Paxos's business and infrastructure development?
9104a902f4.a: The GENIUS Act created a regulatory framework that defines stablecoins as payment instruments, providing market clarity. Since GENIUS passed, Paxos is busier than ever, working with dozens of large financial institutions including multiple GSIBs on new stablecoin infrastructure. The regulatory clarity from GENIUS has resulted in multiples more infrastructure being laid than would otherwise have occurred.

This regulatory constraint was a trade-off for pursuing a highly regulated business model.
